idea: 将时序排名算子（ts_rank）与模板1的截面极端检测相结合，构建双重极端性验证。要求效率比率的短期变化既在行业横截面上偏离超过1.2个标准差，又在其自身过去60日时序分布中处于顶部或底部15%的极端分位，才触发交易信号。出场或中性期则使用更短窗口（10日）的平滑处理，确保信号兼具横截面异质性与时序稀缺性。
expression_list: trade_when(and(greater(ts_rank(abs(group_zscore(ts_delta(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 5), industry)), 60), 0.85), greater(abs(group_zscore(ts_delta(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 5), industry)), 1.2)), group_zscore(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 10), 5), industry), 0)

trade_when(and(greater(ts_rank(abs(group_zscore(ts_delta(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 5), industry)), 60), 0.85), greater(abs(group_zscore(ts_delta(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 5), industry)), 1.2)), group_zscore(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 10), 5), industry), 0)
